# crit_val_sacf_bp {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
crit_val_sacf_bp(M, N, w; alpha=0.05)
```
Compute the critical value of the Box-Pierce type test based on the spatial autocorrelation function (SACF); see [`test_sacf_bp`](test_sacf_bp.qmd). Under the null hypothesis, `M * N / 2` times the BP statistic is asymptotically `Chisq(K)` distributed with `K = 2w(w + 1)` degrees of freedom.
 
  * `M`, `N`: dimensions of the data matrix.
  * `w::Int`: window size; delays up to `w` in each direction are used.
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level.


:::
